Method of Attack: Installer replaced with malware that overwrites the master boot record (MBR) to display a message on reboot
Attack Vector: Compromised external developer account on FossHub download server
Indicators of Compromise: Malware installer showing publisher as Unknown instead of Ivaylo Beltchev
Message on reboot: 'AS YOU REBOOT, YOU FIND THAT SOMETHING HAS OVERWRITTEN YOUR MBR! IT IS A SAD THING YOUR ADVENTURES HAVE ENDED HERE!'
